recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed unless a future Vocab/FHIR-I decision reintroduces or renames the all-media-types value set.
issue_request: FHIR-36705 asked that Expression.language stop using the obsolete http://www.rfc-editor.org/bcp/bcp13.txt maxBinding and instead use the R5 media-type value set.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 8d74e147a505af1f37628052a63002b7a88d8d02 and merged by 3707e60601831442b157f84df88a8e91db0f7bc6, changing the ExpressionLanguage maximum binding in source/datatypes/expression.xml to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/mimetypes.
additional_context: Expression is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. The Jira text named AllMediaTypes, but later FHIR-36752 deleted the redundant valueset-all-media-types artifact and confirmed ValueSet/mimetypes as the replacement; that issue is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source and published R5/current Expression profiles already expose Expression.language's maximum binding as http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/mimetypes, and valueset-all-media-types is not a current published/build-scoped artifact.

related_jiras.note: Removed the redundant valueset-all-media-types artifact and confirmed ValueSet/mimetypes as the active replacement; already represented on the combined branch.
